notes: ruling: a narrated visit where the Imam speaks and acts (rule 11); the Imam's words «فقال لي أبو عبد الله» are the saying, so he is written as the last link (owner ruling 2)

«أبي عبد الله جعفر» in the visit is a name in the scene, not a link
